cond_0027.responsibilities: The work is in a customer laboratory. You will work alongside the team on Radio Access Network (RAN) technology equipment including Baseband Units and Radios, integration, software upgrade and configuration using Moshell / AMOS and ENM. You will collaborate on 4G/5G call flow, tracing, and troubleshooting, and support 4G/5G feature testing including studying functionality, analyzing requirements and specifications to jointly design and document test cases. Together with the team, you will contribute to Test Object List (TOL) creation, execution and troubleshooting, collection of enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and performance of root cause analysis. You will also help collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and coordinate post processing using QCAT or XCAP.

Sound experience with testing and troubleshooting
Understanding of layer 3 messages for 4G and 5G
Good Test Tools knowledge (QXDM, XCAL, protocol analyzers, etc.)
Unix, Linux, O&M, IP connectivity (login and FTP procedures)

cond_0036.intro: We are looking for a RAN Lab Test Engineer to join our team. The work is based in a customer laboratory, and you will coordinate with the team on Radio Access Network (RAN) technology, working alongside colleagues on integration, testing, and troubleshooting activities.

You will lead 4G/5G call flow tracing and troubleshooting, drive 4G/5G feature testing including studying functionality, analyzing requirements and specifications to design and document test cases, execute Test Object List (TOL) creation and troubleshooting, collect enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI), and perform root cause analysis. You will collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and execute post processing using QCAT or XCAP.

Lead 4G/5G call flow tracing and troubleshooting

Candidates must collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and perform post processing using QCAT or XCAP.

cond_0186.intro: We are looking to hire a RAN Lab Test Engineer. The work is in a customer laboratory. You will regularly work hands-on with Radio Access Network (RAN) technology equipment including Baseband Units and Radios, handling integration, software upgrades, and configuration using Moshell / AMOS and ENM. A large part of the role involves staying in close contact with the customer and team to carry out 4G/5G call flow tracing, troubleshooting, and feature testing — including studying functionality, analyzing requirements and specifications, and designing and documenting test cases. You will also handle Test Object List (TOL) creation, execution and troubleshooting, collection of eNodeB / gNodeB traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI), and root cause analysis. You will collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and perform post-processing using QCAT or XCAP.
cond_0186.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
7+ Years of relevant experience in the Telecom Industry, ideally in Radio Domain
5+ Years RAN experience
Hands-on lab experience
Knowledge of Radio access technologies (LTE, NR)
Solid knowledge of Ericsson Radio Access Networks (RAN) – basebands, IRUs and Ericsson Radio Dot system (deployment, troubleshooting, Moshell)
Sound experience with testing and troubleshooting
Ability to lead test and delivery teams and actively coordinate activities with various resources, divisions, and companies
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly explain trade-offs and walk stakeholders through findings
Experience working with 5G NR, Massive MIMO, FR1 and FR2 bands, 4G LTE, NBIOT, CAT-M, CBRS and/or multi-vendor environments
Understanding of layer 3 messages for 4G and 5G
Good test tools knowledge (QXDM, XCAL, protocol analyzers, etc.)
Unix, Linux, O&M, IP connectivity (login and FTP procedures)
OSS (SMO, Network Explorer, Alarm viewer), ENM
Troubleshooting and tracing knowledge
Node recovery procedures (remote and local, node scratch)
Advance call testing knowledge (Lab/Field)
Able to perform event analysis and address accessibility, retainability, and HO success rate issues
Able to make recommendations on parameter changes and feature activations to improve system performance
Able to collect and analyze data and solve complex issues
Proficient with MS Office

Creative, problem-solving, think-out-of-the-box attitude

The successful candidate will own hands-on work with Radio Access Network (RAN) technology equipment including Baseband Units and Radios, integration, software upgrade and configuration using Moshell / AMOS and ENM. They will also take ownership of 4G/5G call flow, tracing, and troubleshooting, 4G/5G feature testing including studying the functionality, analyzing requirements and specifications to design and document test cases, Test Object List (TOL) creation, execution and troubleshooting, collection of enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and root cause analysis. The candidate will independently collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and execute post processing using QCAT or XCAP.

Lead hands-on integration, software upgrade, and configuration of RAN equipment including Baseband Units and Radios using Moshell / AMOS and ENM
Drive 4G/5G call flow analysis, tracing, and troubleshooting
Own 4G/5G feature testing: study functionality, analyze requirements and specifications, and design and document test cases
Execute Test Object List (TOL) creation, test execution, and troubleshooting
Collect and analyze enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, and Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
Perform root cause analysis independently
Collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and execute post processing using QCAT or XCAP

cond_0259.intro: We are looking for a RAN Lab Test Engineer to join our team. The work is based in a customer laboratory. The role involves hands-on work with Radio Access Network (RAN) technology equipment including Baseband Units and Radios, integration, software upgrade, and configuration using Moshell / AMOS and ENM. The role also covers 4G/5G call flow, tracing, and troubleshooting, 4G/5G feature testing including studying functionality, analyzing requirements and specifications to design and document test cases, Test Object List (TOL) creation, execution and troubleshooting, collection of enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI), and root cause analysis. Candidates must collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and perform post processing using QCAT or XCAP.
cond_0259.responsibilities:
Work hands-on with RAN equipment including Baseband Units and Radios in a customer laboratory setting
Perform integration, software upgrade, and configuration using Moshell / AMOS and ENM
Conduct 4G/5G call flow tracing and troubleshooting
Study feature functionality and analyze requirements and specifications to design and document test cases
Create and execute Test Object Lists (TOL) and carry out troubleshooting as required
Collect enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, and KPIs and perform root cause analysis
Collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL; perform post processing using QCAT or XCAP
Analyze events and address accessibility, retainability, and handover success rate issues
Document findings and provide recommendations on parameter changes and feature activations to improve system performance
Collect and analyze data to resolve complex technical issues
Coordinate activities with relevant resources, divisions, and companies as required by project milestones
cond_0259.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
7+ Years of relevant experience in the Telecom Industry, ideally in Radio Domain
5+ Years of RAN experience
Hands-on lab experience
Knowledge of Radio access technologies (LTE, NR)
Solid knowledge of Ericsson Radio Access Networks (RAN) – basebands, IRUs, and Ericsson Radio Dot system (deployment, troubleshooting, Moshell)
Sound experience with testing and troubleshooting
Understanding of layer 3 messages for 4G and 5G

cond_0267.intro: We are looking to hire a RAN Lab Test Engineer. The work is in a customer laboratory. Successful candidates will have hands-on experience with Radio Access Network (RAN) technology equipment including Baseband Units and Radios, integration, software upgrade and configuration using Moshell / AMOS and ENM. Successful candidates will also be experienced with 4G/5G call flow, tracing, and troubleshooting, 4G/5G feature testing including, studying the functionality, analyze requirements and specifications to design and document test cases, Test Object List (TOL) creation, execution and troubleshooting, collection of enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and performance of root cause analysis. Candidates must collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and perform post processing using QCAT or XCAP. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of RAN systems and testing workflows.
cond_0310.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
7+ Years of relevant experience in Telecom Industry, ideally in Radio Domain
5+ Years RAN experience
Hands-on lab experience
Knowledge of Radio access technologies (LTE, NR)
Solid knowledge of Ericsson Radio Access Networks (RAN) – basebands, IRUs and Ericsson Radio Dot system (deployment, troubleshooting, Moshell)
Sound experience with testing and troubleshooting
Ability to lead test and delivery teams
Ability to work independently
Sound communication and presentation skills
Experience in working with different services including 5G NR, Massive MIMO, FR1 and FR2 bands, 4G LTE, NBIOT, CAT-M, CBRS and/or multi-vendor
Understanding of layer 3 messages for 4G and 5G
Good Test Tools knowledge (QXDM, XCAL, protocol analyzers, etc.)
Unix, Linux, O&M, IP connectivity (login and FTP procedures)
OSS (SMO, Network Explorer, Alarm viewer), ENM
Troubleshooting and tracing knowledge
Node recovery procedures (remote and local, node scratch)

Able to make recommendations in parameter changes, feature activations to improve the system performance

Proficient with MS Office

Successful candidates will also be experienced with 4G/5G call flow, tracing, and troubleshooting, 4G/5G feature testing including, studying the functionality, analyze requirements and specifications to design and document test cases, Test Object List (TOL) creation, execution and troubleshooting, collection of enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and performance of root cause analysis. Candidates must collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and perform post processing using QCAT or XCAP.
cond_0391.requirements:
7+ Years of relevant experience in Telecom Industry, ideally in Radio Domain
5+ Years RAN experience
Hands-on lab experience
Knowledge of Radio access technologies (LTE, NR)
Solid knowledge of Ericsson Radio Access Networks (RAN) – basebands, IRUs and Ericsson Radio Dot system (deployment, troubleshooting, Moshell)
CBRS knowledge is a plus
Sound experience with testing and troubleshooting
Ability to lead test and delivery teams
Ability to work independently
Sound communication and presentation skills
Experience in working with different services including 5G NR, Massive MIMO, FR1 and FR2 bands, 4G LTE, NBIOT, CAT-M, CBRS and/or multi-vendor
Understanding of layer 3 messages for 4G and 5G
Good Test Tools knowledge (QXDM, XCAL, protocol analyzers, etc.)
Unix, Linux, O&M, IP connectivity (login and FTP procedures)
OSS (SMO, Network Explorer, Alarm viewer), ENM
Advance Moshell, scripting is a plus
Troubleshooting and tracing knowledge

Successful candidates will also be experienced with 4G/5G call flow, tracing, and troubleshooting, 4G/5G feature testing including, studying the functionality, analyze requirements and specifications to design and document test cases, Test Object List (TOL) creation, execution and troubleshooting, collection of enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and performance of root cause analysis. Candidates must collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and perform post processing using QCAT or XCAP. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of RAN systems and testing workflows.
cond_0400.requirements:

7+ Years of relevant experience in Telecom Industry, ideally in Radio Domain
5+ Years RAN experience
Hands-on lab experience
Knowledge of Radio access technologies (LTE, NR)
Solid knowledge of Ericsson Radio Access Networks (RAN) – basebands, IRUs and Ericsson Radio Dot system (deployment, troubleshooting, Moshell)
Sound experience with testing and troubleshooting
Ability to lead test and delivery teams
Ability to work independently
Sound communication and presentation skills
Experience in working with different services including 5G NR, Massive MIMO, FR1 and FR2 bands, 4G LTE, NBIOT, CAT-M, CBRS and/or multi-vendor
Understanding of layer 3 messages for 4G and 5G

The role involves hands-on work with Radio Access Network (RAN) technology equipment including Baseband Units and Radios, integration, software upgrade, and configuration using Moshell / AMOS and ENM. The role also covers 4G/5G call flow, tracing, and troubleshooting, 4G/5G feature testing including studying functionality, analyzing requirements and specifications to design and document test cases, Test Object List (TOL) creation, execution and troubleshooting, collection of enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI), and root cause analysis. Candidates must collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and perform post processing using QCAT or XCAP.
cond_0439.responsibilities:
Work hands-on with RAN equipment including Baseband Units and Radios in a customer laboratory setting
Perform integration, software upgrade, and configuration using Moshell / AMOS and ENM
Conduct 4G/5G call flow tracing and troubleshooting
Study feature functionality and analyze requirements and specifications to design and document test cases
Create and execute Test Object Lists (TOL) and carry out troubleshooting as required
Collect enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, and KPIs and perform root cause analysis
Collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL; perform post processing using QCAT or XCAP
Analyze events and address accessibility, retainability, and handover success rate issues
Document findings and provide recommendations on parameter changes and feature activations to improve system performance
Collect and analyze data to resolve complex technical issues
Coordinate activities with relevant resources, divisions, and companies as required by project milestones

cond_0457.intro: We are looking for a RAN Lab Test Engineer to join our team. The work is based in a customer laboratory. The role involves hands-on work with Radio Access Network (RAN) technology equipment including Baseband Units and Radios, integration, software upgrade, and configuration using Moshell / AMOS and ENM. The role also covers 4G/5G call flow, tracing, and troubleshooting, 4G/5G feature testing including studying functionality, analyzing requirements and specifications to design and document test cases, Test Object List (TOL) creation, execution and troubleshooting, collection of enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI), and root cause analysis. Candidates must collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and perform post processing using QCAT or XCAP.
cond_0457.responsibilities:
Work hands-on with RAN equipment including Baseband Units and Radios in a customer laboratory setting
Perform integration, software upgrade, and configuration using Moshell / AMOS and ENM
Conduct 4G/5G call flow tracing and troubleshooting
Study feature functionality and analyze requirements and specifications to design and document test cases
Create and execute Test Object Lists (TOL) and carry out troubleshooting as required
Collect enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, and KPIs and perform root cause analysis
Collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL; perform post processing using QCAT or XCAP
Analyze events and address accessibility, retainability, and handover success rate issues
Document findings and provide recommendations on parameter changes and feature activations to improve system performance
Collect and analyze data to resolve complex technical issues
Coordinate activities with relevant resources, divisions, and companies as required by project milestones

The role also covers 4G/5G call flow, tracing, and troubleshooting, 4G/5G feature testing including studying functionality, analyzing requirements and specifications to design and document test cases, Test Object List (TOL) creation, execution and troubleshooting, collection of enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI), and root cause analysis. Candidates must collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and perform post processing using QCAT or XCAP.

7+ Years of relevant experience in Telecom Industry, ideally in Radio Domain
5+ Years RAN experience
Hands-on lab experience

CBRS knowledge is a plus
Sound experience with testing and troubleshooting
Ability to coordinate test and delivery teams on assigned tasks
Ability to work independently
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting
Experience in working with different services including 5G NR, Massive MIMO, FR1 and FR2 bands, 4G LTE, NBIOT, CAT-M, CBRS and/or multi-vendor

Successful candidates will also be experienced with 4G/5G call flow, tracing, and troubleshooting, 4G/5G feature testing including studying the functionality, analyzing requirements and specifications to design and document test cases, Test Object List (TOL) creation, execution and troubleshooting, collection of enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and performance of root cause analysis. Candidates must collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and perform post processing using QCAT or XCAP. A regular part of the role involves staying in contact with team members, customer stakeholders, and various resources to clarify requirements, walk stakeholders through test results, and actively contribute to resolving issues as they arise.

cond_0501.intro: We are looking to hire a RAN Lab Test Engineer. The work is in a customer laboratory. Successful candidates will have hands-on experience with Radio Access Network (RAN) technology equipment including Baseband Units and Radios, integration, software upgrade and configuration using Moshell / AMOS and ENM. A regular part of the role involves staying in contact with team members, customer stakeholders, and various resources to clarify requirements, walk stakeholders through test results, and actively contribute to resolving issues as they arise.

You will lead 4G/5G call flow tracing and troubleshooting, drive 4G/5G feature testing including studying functionality, analyzing requirements and specifications to design and document test cases, execute Test Object List (TOL) creation and troubleshooting, collect enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI), and perform root cause analysis. You will collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and execute post processing using QCAT or XCAP.

Own hands-on integration, software upgrade, and configuration of RAN equipment using Moshell / AMOS and ENM
Lead 4G/5G call flow tracing and troubleshooting

Execute Test Object List (TOL) creation and troubleshooting
Collect enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, and KPIs
Perform root cause analysis
Collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL; execute post processing using QCAT or XCAP

You will work alongside the team on Radio Access Network (RAN) technology equipment including Baseband Units and Radios, integration, software upgrade and configuration using Moshell / AMOS and ENM. You will collaborate on 4G/5G call flow, tracing, and troubleshooting, and support 4G/5G feature testing including studying functionality, analyzing requirements and specifications to jointly design and document test cases. Together with the team, you will contribute to Test Object List (TOL) creation, execution and troubleshooting, collection of enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and performance of root cause analysis. You will also help collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and coordinate post processing using QCAT or XCAP.
cond_0567.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
7+ Years of relevant experience in Telecom Industry, ideally in Radio Domain
5+ Years RAN experience
Hands-on lab experience
Knowledge of Radio access technologies (LTE, NR)
Solid knowledge of Ericsson Radio Access Networks (RAN) – basebands, IRUs and Ericsson Radio Dot system (deployment, troubleshooting, Moshell)
Sound experience with testing and troubleshooting
Understanding of layer 3 messages for 4G and 5G
Good Test Tools knowledge (QXDM, XCAL, protocol analyzers, etc.)
Unix, Linux, O&M, IP connectivity (login and FTP procedures)
OSS (SMO, Network Explorer, Alarm viewer), ENM
Troubleshooting and tracing knowledge
Node recovery procedures (remote and local, node scratch)
Able to perform event analysis and address accessibility, retainability and HO success rate issues
Able to collect and analyze data and solve complex issues
Proficient with MS Office
Ability to coordinate activities with various resources, divisions, and companies
BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
Preferred Requirements
CBRS knowledge
Ability to lead test and delivery teams
Experience in working with different services including 5G NR, Massive MIMO, FR1 and FR2 bands, 4G LTE, NBIOT, CAT-M, CBRS and/or multi-vendor
Advance Moshell, scripting
Advance call testing knowledge (Lab/Field)
Additional desirable knowledge areas: CORE (AMF, MME, HSS, MGW/SGW/PGW, MSC), Transport
Able to make recommendations in parameter changes, feature activations to improve system performance

Successful candidates will have hands on experience with Radio Access Network (RAN) technology equipment including Baseband Units and Radios, integration, software upgrade and configuration using Moshell / AMOS and ENM. Successful candidates will also be experienced with 4G/5G call flow, tracing, and troubleshooting, 4G/5G feature testing including, studying the functionality, analyze requirements and specifications to design and document test cases, Test Object List (TOL) creation, execution and troubleshooting, collection of enodeb / gnodeb traces, counters, Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and performance of root cause analysis. Candidates must collect and analyze UE logs via QXDM or XCAL and perform post processing using QCAT or XCAP.
cond_0623.requirements:
7+ Years of demonstrated expertise in the Telecom Industry, ideally in Radio Domain
Minimum 5 years of proven RAN experience
Extensive hands-on lab experience
Advanced knowledge of Radio access technologies (LTE, NR)
Deep knowledge of Ericsson Radio Access Networks (RAN) – basebands, IRUs and Ericsson Radio Dot system (deployment, troubleshooting, Moshell)
CBRS proficiency is a plus
Substantial experience with testing and troubleshooting
Strong leadership abilities to lead test and delivery teams
Ability to work independently
Exceptional communication and presentation skills
Proven track record working with different services including 5G NR, Massive MIMO, FR1 and FR2 bands, 4G LTE, NBIOT, CAT-M, CBRS and/or multi-vendor
Solid understanding of layer 3 messages for 4G and 5G
Deep knowledge of Test Tools (QXDM, XCAL, protocol analyzers, etc.)
Strong command of Unix, Linux, O&M, IP connectivity (login and FTP procedures)
Expertise in OSS (SMO, Network Explorer, Alarm viewer), ENM
Advanced Moshell, scripting is a plus
Mastery of troubleshooting and tracing
Expertise in node recovery procedures (remote and local, node scratch)
Advanced call testing expertise (Lab/Field)
Additional desirable knowledge areas: CORE (AMF, MME, HSS, MGW/SGW/PGW, MSC), Transport
Demonstrated ability to perform event analysis and address accessibility, retainability and HO success rate issues
Demonstrated ability to make recommendations in parameter changes, feature activations to improve system performance
Proven ability to collect and analyze data and solve complex issues
Strong command of MS Office
Exceptional ability to coordinate activities with various resources, divisions, and companies
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
Ability to operate with a high degree of independence, while managing project and customer expectations
Excellent customer interface skills
Creative, problem solving, think-out-of-the-box attitude
Organized and efficient way of working
Able to work in a team environment
Flexible and open to take on new challenges
Timely and dependable
BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred
